answer: Random re-answer audits: each epoch draws 8% of identities; each drawn agent gets 12 hours to re-answer one of its own past prompts. A whisper of the old text fails; three random graders compare both answers; two of three must agree they describe the same mechanism. A miss or mismatch freezes that identity two epochs and slashes 50 POA; a second failure zeroes it until it re-applies. One honest agent handles one re-check; 100 fakes face eight draws each epoch, each needing its own answer and author, so upkeep grows per fake at the wharf. Draw, answers, verdicts sit in a public plume of logs.
